title: Around the World in 80 Days
author: d'après Jules Verne
desc: Phileas Fogg parie qu'il peut faire le tour du monde en 80 jours. Le compte à rebours commence.

p: In London, in 1872, there lived a very strange gentleman: Mr. Phileas Fogg. He was rich, calm, and extremely punctual. He got up at the same minute every day. He ate at the same table at his club every day.
One evening at the Reform Club, his friends were reading the newspaper. "With the new railway in India," said one, "you can go around the world in eighty days."
"Impossible!" said another.
"Possible," said Mr. Fogg calmly. "I bet twenty thousand pounds that I can do it."
That was half of his money. His friends accepted the bet.
At eight forty-five that same evening, Mr. Fogg left London with his new French servant, Passepartout, and a big bag of money. "We have until 8:45 p.m. on the 21st of December," he said.
At the same time, a bank in London was robbed. The police thought that the thief looked like Mr. Fogg!
Detective Fix followed Fogg across the world. He wanted to arrest him, but he needed official papers. So he stayed close to Fogg and Passepartout and tried to slow them down.
They travelled by ship to Egypt, then to India. In India, the railway was not finished! Mr. Fogg calmly bought an elephant.

In the jungle, they saw a terrible thing. A young widow, Aouda, was going to be burned with her dead husband. Passepartout hid under the body and "came back to life" during the ceremony. The people ran away, terrified. They saved Aouda, and she continued the journey with them.
From India, they went to Hong Kong, then to Japan. Fix made Passepartout drunk, and Passepartout lost Mr. Fogg. He had to work in a circus in Yokohama to survive! Luckily, Mr. Fogg found him.

They crossed the Pacific Ocean to San Francisco. Then they took the train across America. Indians attacked the train. Passepartout was taken prisoner. Mr. Fogg risked his life and his bet to save him.

In New York, they arrived forty-five minutes late. The ship to England was gone! So Mr. Fogg rented a small ship. When there was no more coal, he burned the wooden parts of the ship to keep the engine running.
When they arrived in Liverpool, England, Detective Fix arrested Mr. Fogg! Later, they discovered that the real thief was already in prison. Fix was wrong. But Mr. Fogg missed his train.
He arrived in London five minutes too late. He had lost the bet. He was ruined.
The next day, he stayed at home, very calm and very sad. Aouda came to him. "Mr. Fogg, I don't care about money. Will you marry me?"
"I love you," said Mr. Fogg. And for the first time, his face showed emotion.
Passepartout ran to the church to organise the wedding for Monday. But the priest said: "Monday? Tomorrow is Sunday. Today is Saturday!"
Travelling east, around the world, they had gained one day! Passepartout ran home. Mr. Fogg ran to the club. At 8:44 and 57 seconds, he opened the door. "Here I am, gentlemen."
He won the bet. But the best thing he won on this journey was Aouda.
